integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof accompanied by finite exact-rational independent enumeration; finite tests are corroborative, not an infinite certificate. Publication priority not independently adjudicated.
scientific_limitations: Proved for positively weighted directed in-stars with the minimum-incoming-edge external worth, at least two leaves, and real interpolation parameters. No assertion for arbitrary directed networks, zero-weight arcs or altered external aggregators.
title: Core boxes and a sharp Shapley-entry threshold in interpolated directed trust stars
